scope: 2D comparison of implementation results with the expected results of the Golden T-Shirt v1 fixture (fixtures/golden-tshirt/v1): evaluated contours and control points, seam lengths, and the control square of 1:1 print output in file coordinates.
notes: PROVISIONAL. These limits are the proposals from the design decisions (design decisions ADR-017.1 §5 and ADR-025 §6), not adopted product norms and not measured values: contour deviation 0.10 mm (Hausdorff distance), relative seam-length deviation 0.5 %, control square 100 mm +/- 0.1 mm in file coordinates (not a physical print). d2p:seam-length-deviation-absolute and d2p:angle-deviation have no proposed value and are omitted. The maintainers MUST set this profile to frozen (as a new version if any value changes) before any implementation or benchmark run is compared against it; once frozen it is immutable and is never adjusted to fit an implementation.
